title: Exactness and common refinements for weak Galois constructibility
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian $\Lambda$-algebra. Work with module sheaves and their ordinary derived categories on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Constructible means locally constant with finitely generated stalks on a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification], [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules], [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. A Galois partition $\mathcal P$ is a finite locally closed stratification of $X$ by connected reduced subschemes $S_i$, with a connected finite etale Galois covering $V_i\to S_i$ for each stratum. Here Galois means that a finite group acts on the cover and acts simply transitively on every geometric fibre. Let $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$ be the class of sheaves whose restriction to each $S_i$ is a filtered colimit of sheaves obtained by finite successive extensions of locally constant $A$-module sheaves which become constant on $V_i$. No finite-generation condition is imposed in $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$. Write $D^b_{\mathcal P}(X,A)$ for bounded complexes whose cohomology sheaves belong to this class. The full subcategory $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$ is abelian, its inclusion into module sheaves is exact, and it is closed under extensions and all filtered colimits. Its full subcategory of constructible objects is also closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions. Given finitely many Galois partitions, there exists a common Galois refinement $\mathcal R$: for every commutative coefficient algebra $B$, each corresponding $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(B)$ is contained in $\mathcal W_{\mathcal R}(B)$. One may choose the refinement directed, meaning that its strata can be ordered so that each is open in the reduced closed complement of its predecessors.
